Opportunities External FactorsExecutive Summary01
The conflict in the Middle East has created volatility in energy
prices and led to a continuous increase in electricity costs.
The change in government has caused delays in public sector
procurement processes, while the private sector has slowed
investment decisions pending clearer policy direction.Customers are increasingly
repatriating their data back
to Thailand and strengthening
their IT foundations in preparation
for Corporate AI adoption.
Government support for the
consumption of Thai products through
the “Thai Chuay Thai” campaign 
is creating growth opportunities 
for Thai E-Commerce platforms.
The continuous decline in Solar and
BESS* prices creates an opportunity
for the company to accelerate Phase 2
development and achieve a faster-
than-expected payback period.
Note:BESS stands for Battery Energy Storage System.
